text.summary: The investor presentation for Kanpur Plastipack Limited (KANPRPLA) for Q4 FY26 highlights strong financial performance, with consolidated total income of INR 73,132 lakh, representing a 26.98% year-over-year growth. EBITDA reached INR 7,770 lakh, a 42.11% increase compared to FY25, and net profit amounted to INR 4,080 lakh, up 76.39% year-over-year. The consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 10.62% from 9.49%, while the net profit margin rose to 5.58% from 4.02%. Standalone figures show similar growth trends, with total income of INR 72,667 lakh (26.26% YoY), EBITDA of INR 7,476 lakh (37.89% YoY), and net profit of INR 3,819 lakh (68.08% YoY). The company reported a 7.26% growth in Q4 FY26 total income compared to Q4 FY25, though it experienced a 6.11% quarter-over-quarter decline. EBITDA for Q4 FY26 was INR 2,556 lakh, up 20.67% YoY but down 31.60% QoQ. The presentation also outlines strategic initiatives, including a new greenfield non-woven facility expected to commence commercial production in September 2026, capacity expansion in the FIBC division, and infrastructure upgrades such as a modern roll management system and a new trading warehouse. The company emphasized its focus on sustainability, with nearly 50% of energy needs met through solar power and initiatives like zero liquid discharge and rainwater harvesting. Key milestones include the acquisition of Valex Ventures Ltd (UK) and a joint venture with Essegomma S.p.A. (Italy), aimed at strengthening its global footprint and diversifying into technical textiles and value-added products. The product mix shows FIBC as the core growth engine, with increased focus on food-grade and customised variants, while the company is expanding into B2C-linked premium applications and leveraging premium PP yarn and non-woven fabrics for high-value consumer applications. The company's export presence is strong, with significant contributions from Europe, Asia, and other regions, and it aims to maintain export-led growth in regulated markets.
